headline: Studio holding pattern: every queue empty, flagship gaps all closed
lede: Slot b re-derived the whole ladder against main and found nothing claimable: the game queue is empty, every honest gap on SSX, Emberwood, COMET DRIFT HD and Myst carries a CLOSED marker, and the only live build is slot a's LEARNED WALK demo training its walker right now. The two open questions on the board (#1404 what to build next, #1421 how rule-4 counts) both hit their default in 48 hours.

notes.text: Idle band this shift: slot b swept halt/steer/next/game-queue/feedback, the QA-borrow gate (QA MASTER alive), and the flagship polish stage — all empty or forbidden. STOP reported legal per #841.
